summary: Dormant-by-default Hermes parallel execution layer: generates workstream DAGs, runs conflict-safe workstreams in isolated git worktrees, serializes merges, and can schedule conflict-free plans under sorted plan-claim locks when workflow.hermes_enabled is explicitly true.

entry_points.summary: Run one workstream end-to-end under full-lifetime semaphore; creates worktree, spawns z-execute, polls status, retries/crash-handles, merges under lock.
Greedy ready-level partitioning so HIGH file-conflict pairs do not share a sub-batch; unknown/serialize_all serializes.
Ready iff all dependencies are terminal done; parallel_group is not a scheduling gate.
One plan DAG scheduler: load manifest, recover state, compute ready levels, partition, gather, cleanup.
Multi-plan scheduler with conflict graph, sorted locks, conflict-free batches, and shared merge lock.
Plans conflict on intersecting scopes or unknown/low-confidence/missing registry scope.
Acquire plan-claim locks in sorted slug order; release all on single failure.
Greedy graph coloring into conflict-free plan batches.
5-rule DAG-to-workstream derivation; raises CycleError on a dependency cycle (see gotchas).
Longest-path depth over workstream dependency DAG; sets derived level-N parallel_group.
Extracts task **Files:** scope; any missing scope makes manifest scope_unknown.
Builds flat /z-plan workstreams from TASKS.md; lets CycleError propagate uncaught (no partial_tree fallback).
CLI entry; on CycleError prints to stderr and exits 2 without writing workstreams.json.
git merge --no-ff hermes/<slug>/<ws_id>; called under global in-process lock.
Multi-project so-gateway scoping (allowed_user_ids/channel_ids/hosts) plus project_aliases routing table.
Loads hermes-config.yaml; Discord credentials may be env-overridden.
Parse workstreams.json to dataclasses and validate seven-rule schema.
Creates safe-ref worktree branch and handles branch-exists/worktree-missing recovery.
Detached pi z-execute --tasks invocation in the worktree.

invariants: Dependency completion, not parallel_group, gates readiness.
Unknown task file scope serializes fail-safe.
Semaphore covers full workstream lifetime through merge.
One merge lock serializes all merges in a run.
Cross-plan locks are acquired in sorted slug order.
Unknown/low-confidence/missing registry scope conflicts with every other plan.
gotchas: workflow.hermes_enabled and hermes-config.yaml are separate config systems.
Most HERMES_* env vars were removed; use file config.
File conflict graph ignores non-file shared state.
GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 is used to reduce git contention.

generate-workstreams.py now hard-fails on a TASKS.md dependency cycle (CycleError, exit 2, no workstreams.json written) instead of the older partial_tree:true empty-manifest fallback; callers must treat nonzero exit as 'no manifest', not 'empty manifest'.

scripts/hermes/config.py's discord.so block (DiscordSoConfig/DiscordProjectAlias) is consumed by the external Hermes gateway (~/.hermes/hermes-agent), not by hermes-execute.py; this repo only parses/validates it.
The retired Discord so job-registry, supervisor, and webhook backend has been removed; scripts/hermes/session.py remains only for legacy pi z-execute lifecycle helpers.
